title: Inbox thread
description: A subject scoped conversation between the human and sela. awaiting is derived from the last message plus an explicit close, never pre-classified.

subject.description: Namespaced object key such as prospect:<source_id> or customer:<id>. Null means a standalone thread.

awaiting.description: Equal to the awaiting_after of the highest seq message, overridden to none by an explicit close.

revision.description: Highest message seq currently stored. Clients pass it back as the optimistic concurrency token.

legacy_id.description: Read-only compatibility id of the legacy inbox item (the integer exposed by legacy_row_refs); null for threads created natively. Removed when legacy routes are retired.
